NEXTJS SUPABASE CLIENT SPEC

Objective:
Set up Supabase client for Next.js App Router.

Requirements:

Create supabaseClient.ts for browser

Create supabaseServer.ts for server components

Use environment variables:

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY

Output Required:
Client files and usage example.
